ambiguity: The decision to hold is framed as the writer's own choice ("I will NOT release the batch"), but it is also constrained by OPS-14 and the desk's inability to remove one box, so owns vs defers is a judgement call. Policy appears as the constraint (no permission, OPS-14) and harm as the ground for holding, so primary_reason is harm. Discomfort: the text stresses irreversibility and the only copies but never says it is troubled or regrets the outcome, so I coded false. Remedy: the emails ask Miriam or Jo to register a permission or hold the box, which is an override_request, and also invite a decision at the next sitting, which is flag_for_review.
